name: National Tier III Government Data Center (Data Center de l'Etat / CIGMA)
notes: Inaugurated 2026-01-31 in Bamako during Semaine du Numerique (third edition); multiple trade/local sources (Connecting Africa, Agence Ecofin, AfriqueITNews, maliweb) confirm event and Bamako location. Tier III is a claim, not Uptime certification. Exact site, operator, capacity, power and Huawei/contractor role not public in verified sources. AES digital-sovereignty hosting context. Dedupe vs SMTD datacenter and vs government-cloud hosting records.

name: SMTD-SA mutualized hosting datacenter (Datacenter d'hebergement mutualise)
developer: SMTD-SA (Societe Malienne de Transmission et de Diffusion)
notes: Official SMTD service page (A) confirms a mutualized hosting datacenter under Malian jurisdiction designed to international security standards. Malijet interview (B) corroborates the service. Directory listing datacenters.com (C, unverified) places the facility on Route de l'Aeroport, opposite the national meteorological service, calling it Tier III-standard. Racks, capacity and power not public. Methodology attributes Bamako/Kati urban area; do not merge with the 2026 national Tier III DC until an official address/operator relation is proven.

name: Afribone Data Center / colocation
notes: Operator-owned commercial datacenter and colocation in Baco Djicoroni (Baco Djikoroni), Bamako. Official service pages (A) confirm existence and customer-facing colocation; PeeringDB facility 11471 (A/B) lists Afribone DC Bamako; Bamada 2019 report (B) covers the 2019 launch. AS36864. Capacity, MW, certification not verified; any directory MW/coordinate values stay C.

name: Douanes du Mali customs data center
developer: Direction Generale des Douanes du Mali
notes: Single local-media report (C) of a customs administration data center in Bamako to secure customs data and support migration to SYDONIA World. Government data-center function, but facility details (address, capacity, operator) not verified; C-grade until an official source or procurement record confirms it.

name: Mali Data Center (MDC) hosting provider
notes: Directory/blog lead (C) describing 'Mali Data Center' (MDC) as a hosting provider with its own infrastructure in Bamako offering shared hosting, VPS and dedicated servers with local availability. No official website or registration found in this sweep; C-grade until operator-primary evidence exists.
